answer: Lock a ferrous bond to open a seat: a non-transferable, epoch-slow stake minted against unique attested work and barred from any other key. In probation the protocol can suddenly issue a gale of address-bound micro-proofs that one runtime fingerprint must solve live; reused or batched solutions fail. At a secret height a short comet window records counterparties, clock skew, and code hash as a path. Near-identical paths merge into one voting seat and leftover ferrous locks burn, so extra identities spend real iron and compute without buying influence.
